title: Duterte impeachment: Witness shows Carpio buying shoes for youth team
summary: MANILA, Philippines — A defense witness on Thursday showed a photo of Atty. Manases Carpio, husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, buying shoes in Malaysia for a youth basketball team in early 2025.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A defense witness on Thursday showed a photo of Atty. Manases Carpio, husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, buying shoes in Malaysia for a youth basketball team in early 2025. It was the prosecution’s expert witness, Atty. Alexander Cabrera, who flagged the P256,882 purchase at a Nike store in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
